about: Ira M. Newman is a distinguished partner at Sanocki, Newman & Turret, LLP, based in New York City, New York. With a legal career that began in 1983, he has honed his shrewd legal acumen in a spectrum of practice areas, including construction and automobile accidents, labor law, personal injury and negligence, medical malpractice, product liability, premises liability, and commercial litigation. His legal practice is not confined to the state of New York; he has successfully represented clients in federal courts across the nation, including some notable cases in California.

Mr. Newman embarked on his legal journey at the Antioch School of Law, now known as the University of the District of Columbia David A. Clarke School of Law, where he contributed as an editor of the Antioch Law Journal. His foundational education was shaped by a Bachelor of Arts from Bucknell University, which he received in 1979. This solid educational grounding has equipped him to navigate and address complex legal challenges with innovative solutions.

Renowned for securing monumental verdicts for his clients, Mr. Newman's record includes a staggering $62 million verdict in a surgical malpractice case and a $32.5 million verdict in a motor vehicle accident case. His strategic prowess in the courtroom, combined with a genuine dedication to his clients, has earned him the prestigious 2014 Litigator Award, placing him in the top 1% of lawyers for catastrophic injury cases.

Apart from his legal practice, Mr. Newman's commitment to the legal community is evident through his active involvement in key associations. He serves on the Board of Directors for the New York State Trial Lawyers Association and is a member of the American Association for Justice. His professional affiliations, along with accolades from his peers, underscore his profound dedication to justice and client advocacy. Whether navigating complex legal terrains or mentoring young lawyers, he stands as a pillar of legal proficiency and ethical practice.
